Dear patient,
Thank you for visiting us. Here is a summary of what your doctor asked you to do.

Your medicines:
- Start taking Furosemide 40 mg once daily in the morning.
- Keep taking Metoprolol 25 mg twice daily.
- Stop taking Amlodipine.

Your next tests and visits:
- Repeat serum electrolytes (BMP) blood test on 2026-12-02.
- Follow-up appointment with cardiology clinic on 2026-12-09.

Warning signs:
Get medical help immediately if you notice any of the warning signs below.
- Weigh yourself daily. Return to ER immediately if weight gain more than 2 kg in 2 days, chest pain or severe shortness of breath.

Heart failure tip: weigh yourself every morning after using the toilet and before breakfast, and write it down.

If you have questions, please call the care coordination desk.

खतरे के संकेत (Warning signs):
Get medical help immediately if you notice any of the warning signs below.
- Seek urgent care if signs of dehydration, vomiting or abdominal pain.

Diabetes tip: take Metformin with food to reduce stomach upset, and drink enough water.

If you have questions, please call the care coordination desk.
